Serve the explorer for the reports of a folder

Source: R/explorer_service.R
cwp_explorer_service.Rd

Starts the explorer as a service, so that the links of the HTML reports open it directly on their data. A link gives the steps to explore and the filters to select in its address, for example http://127.0.0.1:8765/?steps=entities/my_dataset/Markdown/rawdata,entities/my_dataset/Markdown/final&source_authority=IOTC.

Usage

cwp_explorer_service(
  root = ".",
  port = cwp_explorer_port(),
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  launch.browser = FALSE
)

Arguments

root

Folder served: only the steps inside it can be explored. The paths in the links are relative to it. For the reports of summarising_step(), the folder of the job (its main_dir).

port, host

Where the service listens. The default port is the one of the links, options(CWP.dataset.explorer_port = ) to change it. Use host = "0.0.0.0" on a server.

launch.browser

Open the start page in a browser.

Value

Does not return while the service runs.

Details

Run it on your computer (the default address is the one the reports link to), or on a server (RStudio Server, a Docker container...) with access to the folder of the jobs. In that case, render the reports with options(CWP.dataset.explorer_url = "<address of the service>", CWP.dataset.explorer_root = "<folder served>") so that their links point to it.

Examples

if (interactive() && requireNamespace("shiny", quietly = TRUE)) {
  cwp_explorer_service("path/to/the/job")
}
